name: Pendragon
description: (Tag:draconic)(Tag:energy-regeneration+)(Tag:martial)(Tag:maximum-energy+)(Tag:physical+)(Tag:social)(Tag:talent)You are a child of Pendragon, the destined rightful King and Dragon. Sovereignty runs in your blood: you more strongly resist negative mental conditions and possess incredible talent for ruling-related matters such as litigation, management, military, economics, etc., plus increased natural charisma. As the child of one recognized as a Dragon, you have increased physical abilities, larger energy reserves, and faster energy recovery. You also have incredible talent with blades from Excalibur's wielder's blood, especially magical swords.
